title: The lead change and shift clearing both succeed or both fail
custom_preconds:
1. You are on the Work Orders page on the build under test, signed in with permission to reassign work orders.
  2. A work order (for example S2-17578) has a current lead technician who has scheduled shifts on the Schedule.
  3. A way to make the shift-clearing step fail is available (for example the Schedule service is briefly unavailable). If this cannot be forced by hand, this check is for automation - see the AUTOMATION note.
custom_steps:
1. Reassign the lead technician and choose to clear shifts, in a run where the shift clearing fails.
  2. Read whether the lead technician was changed, and read the message that appears.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • The lead change and the shift clearing succeed or fail together: if clearing fails, the lead technician is not changed and the failure message (S4-N8) shows.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10043 (Work Orders — Board View & Tech View Display Options). Story reference: SV-10047 — Reassign or unassign the lead technician. Spec: Confluence page 845185030 “Work Orders — Board View & Tech View Display Options”, PRD v33 (2026-09-28), requirement(s) S4-R27 (read 30 Sep 2026). Review decisions/answers: Confluence page 853901313 where cited. Source-verified on 30 September 2026; not yet build-verified.
